name: Open for Business
author: Simitone
description: A home business, after The Sims 2: Open for Business. Put objects in your house up for sale at a price you choose, and visiting Sims buy them. Restock what sells, make an object the till for one of the family to tend, and buy a community lot to run as a shop. Stages 1 to 3 of several. Experimental.
